Usage: astryx experimental icon map [options] [definition] [icon]

[experimental] Register which icon of your set draws an icon definition

Options:
  --set <name>    The set to edit, when the package ships several
  --remove        Remove the definition's entry; takes no icon
  --pairs <list>  Many entries in one write: <definition>=<icon> pairs, comma-separated; checked together, all or none; an existing entry is replaced
  -h, --help      display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the entry is written, removed, or already as asked
  1  the definition is unknown, the set has no such icon, or no set is found

Examples:
  # Map a definition
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon map delete trash
  # Map many at once
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon map --pairs close=x-mark,error=x-circle,search=magnifying-glass
  # Remove an entry
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon map delete --remove

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/experimental-icon-map
